title: Production Soil-Water Solver-Service Transaction Composition

source_authority.source_reconciliation_reason: F-CI39 admitted F-PM06E production changes on the B1.10 soil-water dependency surface after the initial F-KT15 checkpoint; production implementation must therefore continue from the green F-CI39 canonical authority.

problem: The current B1.10 physical transaction executes legacy soilwater/HeadCalc directly and therefore never receives the structured F-SI28 soil_water_solve_result_t needed by the qualified F-KT14 bridge.
goal: Qualify a real production physical transaction composition that obtains its soil-water result from the existing qualified solver service and maps the accepted sensitivity into the F-KT14 transaction carrier without creating another hydraulic authority.
hard_constraints: Do not add interface-tangent computation to legacy HeadCalc.
Do not run a second nonlinear trajectory merely to obtain a tangent.
Do not duplicate the F-SI28 Jacobian/tangent authority.
Preserve B1.10 physical results and hard water balance within the admitted scope.
Rejected/retried solver results and transactions publish no sensitivity.
Preserve worker-owned scratch and compact committed physical state.
Do not add MODFLOW sign conversion.
Do not claim a local-terminal tangent is a whole-coupling-window derivative.
Preserve the admitted F-PM06E surface-evaporation-capacity production source and fail closed outside its qualified scope.

first_design_gate.question: Can the existing B1.10 transaction adapter delegate only the soil-water solve to reference_richards_legacy_solver_t while keeping the surrounding physical interval/process ordering and all continuation-relevant HeadCalc state identical, or is a narrower state-complete production composition seam required first?
first_design_gate.fail_closed_rule: If exact equivalence of surrounding B1.10 process sequencing, continuation state and mass ownership cannot be established, do not replace the legacy interval wholesale; qualify a narrower state-complete seam first.

planned_evidence: HeadCalc state ownership and lifetime matrix
baseline versus solver-service physical continuation state and flux identity
accepted sensitivity reaches trial_outcome_t through the F-KT14 bridge
zero additional nonlinear tangent trajectories and zero additional Jacobian builds
